# Paths whose change can break the public assistant's answers (T-7788). A jc range from the last
# prod pin to a candidate that touches one of them needs a PASS of the assistant gate
# (bins/jc/smoke/assistant-gate) on jc-dev for the candidate's image digest before prod.
# Syntax (.github/scripts/assistant-gate.py): one glob per line, `**` any number of folders, `*`
# within one name, a leading `!` takes matches of earlier lines back out; `#` starts a comment.
# Its selftest checks every line still matches a tracked file.
